long_biography.plain_text:
After university, Lachlan Murdoch moved into the family's Australian newspaper operations and rose through publishing and television management. As a senior News Corporation executive, he helped direct the early investment in property platform REA, which became a major corporate asset. He left the group in 2005 to establish Illyria, then acquired and developed the radio business now known as NOVA Entertainment.

Murdoch returned to the public family companies and now leads Fox Corporation while chairing News Corp. The companies and family trusts, rather than Murdoch alone, own the central media assets and shareholdings. Under the post-2025 structure, a managing director he appoints makes voting and disposition decisions for shares held by LGC Holdco. That authority gives him corporate voting control while remaining legally distinct from sole personal ownership of the trusts' economic interests.
long_biography.html:
After university, Lachlan Murdoch moved into the family's Australian newspaper operations and rose through publishing and television management. As a senior News Corporation executive, he helped direct the early investment in property platform REA, which became a major corporate asset. He left the group in 2005 to establish Illyria, then acquired and developed the radio business now known as NOVA Entertainment.

Murdoch returned to the public family companies and now leads Fox Corporation while chairing News Corp. The companies and family trusts, rather than Murdoch alone, own the central media assets and shareholdings. Under the post-2025 structure, a managing director he appoints makes voting and disposition decisions for shares held by LGC Holdco. That authority gives him corporate voting control while remaining legally distinct from sole personal ownership of the trusts' economic interests.

uncertainties.detail: SEC reporting may deem Murdoch a beneficial owner because he can appoint the manager who directs LGC Holdco's votes and dispositions. The dossier does not convert that reporting convention into a claim that he personally owns every share held by LGC Holdco or every underlying Fox and News Corp asset. Separate trusts benefit Lachlan, Grace and Chloe Murdoch.

The family media interests remain the principal origin mechanism. Inherited and expanded is used because Fox's detailed official biography documents material operating contributions to REA and NOVA, not because of passive appreciation or succession to voting control alone.

The source record already stores British as the main nationality. Australian is proposed as the secondary nationality because the canonical biographical record identifies Australian citizenship and the broader public record consistently treats him as Australian. Public descriptions also sometimes call him American, but no comparably direct source located in this pass established United States citizenship, and the two available nationality fields cannot represent every descriptive label.

The input URL contains two spaces between Lachlan and Murdoch and is malformed. The canonical page is https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lachlan_Murdoch. Because Wikipedia type 10 already exists and duplicate social proposals are not appropriate, the dossier records the canonical source and flags the existing link for manual normalization rather than proposing a second entry.
Forbes publishes multiple articles about Murdoch but no dedicated personal profile was found. Those articles support background claims but do not qualify for a Forbes social-profile proposal.
